name: Vibe Stage
author: Ninepoint Labs
description: Vibe Stage — YouTube Music, Pocket Casts, and Audible in one bar chip with tabbed sources. Keyboard-first.

barWidget.description: One media chip for YouTube Music, podcasts and audiobooks, and a panel with a tab for each source
